This '''[[Commander/Legends|commander]]''' was in charge of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derricon]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[T'Charek Haathi]] nominally reported to the commander, but had free rein during her operations.<ref name="Ship Jackers" />
